name: dblens
description: Checks EF Core migrations against a copy of your database before they reach production. Read-only.
long_description: Before a migration ships: what it locks or rewrites at the tables' real size, what it destroys, and what production holds that the EF Core model does not know (pending or hand-applied migrations, missing columns and indexes). Also: schema overview, undeclared foreign keys (from naming, views, routines and query history), index health, fragmentation, GDPR exposure, cascade paths, migration safety, query plans and a generated data map. For a shared database connect it with a read-only login: dblens refuses to execute caller SQL on a remote login that can write.

postgres_connection.title: PostgreSQL connection string
postgres_connection.description: Leave empty to use the local demo database (localhost:5433, see the README). Otherwise a read-only login, e.g. Host=db;Port=5432;Database=erp;Username=dblens_reader;Password=…

sqlserver_connection.title: SQL Server connection string
sqlserver_connection.description: Leave empty to use the local demo database (localhost,1434, see the README). Otherwise a read-only login, e.g. Server=db;Database=erp;User Id=dblens_reader;Password=…;TrustServerCertificate=true
